formal_role: Defines the admissible set for inversion
systems_modeling_role: Identifies the regime or branch under which recovery is meaningful
review_warning: Changing the domain can change or destroy the inverse

formal_role: Different admissible inputs produce different outputs
systems_modeling_role: Supports uniqueness of recovered states or parameters
review_warning: Many-to-one models make inverse interpretation ambiguous

formal_role: Nonzero derivative or invertible Jacobian supports local inverse recovery
systems_modeling_role: Allows local reconstruction near an operating point
review_warning: Local invertibility does not imply global invertibility

formal_role: Inverse sensitivity depends on reciprocal derivative or inverse Jacobian
review_warning: Ill-conditioned inverse maps make precise recovery misleading

formal_role: Parameters or states must be recoverable from outputs
systems_modeling_role: Connects inverse functions with calibration and diagnosis
review_warning: Similar outputs from different inputs weaken interpretive claims
